notes.title: What's new
notes.intro: Hi! Hermes can use a Desktop Gateway now, and bots live in the sidebar. I also rebuilt the lists and sheets, and fixed a few bugs that had been sitting too long.

bullets.text: Hermes Bot Mode: connect a Desktop Gateway, pick a bot from the sidebar, and consecutive replies share one header.
Native grouped lists, iOS 26 glass, system fonts, and a tablet sidebar you can resize.
Replies stream with less hitching. LaTeX actually draws. Voice no longer answers itself. Polish is in the language list.
